title: Two transitions compete for one token
text: The transitions `left` and `right` both take one token from `offer`. With one token, both are enabled, but only one of them can fire: once `left` has consumed the token, the input place of `right` is empty and `right` is no longer enabled.

steps.text: The transition `left` consumes the only token.
The place `offer` is empty, so `right` cannot fire.
